summary: Verified the new Periodization 'Estructura' edit modals (Macrociclo/Mesociclo/Microciclo) on preview as admin juegolaureado@gmail.com. ALL acceptance criteria PASS: (1) modals open with WHITE background (computed bg rgb(255,255,255), text rgb(15,23,42)/slate-900) and are fully legible; (2) each modal exposes the new Volumen %, Intensidad % and Progreso % inputs alongside Nombre/Fase|Tipo/Semanas (data-testids: macro|meso|micro-{volume,intensity,progress}-input); (3) saving works without errors, modals close, toast 'Macrociclo/Mesociclo/Microciclo actualizado' appears and rollup re-render keeps the 4 macrocycles intact (Acumulación Vol updated 72% → 75%); (4) microcycle volume manually set to 88 persists after save (viLocked) – reopening the modal shows volume=88, confirming the lock is respected; (5) zero JS pageerrors and zero non-hydration console errors during the entire flow.

issues: Console still emits the pre-existing React hydration warnings: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>/<tr>' from stray <span data-ve-dynamic="true"> wrappers in DashboardPage. Non-blocking, already documented in iterations 60/61/63.

Macrocycle cards rendered with data-testid macrocycle-0..3.
test_results_by_feature.macrocycle_edit_modal: PASS – Edit (pencil) button = first <button> inside macrocycle-0 card. Modal opens; computed bg rgb(255,255,255), color rgb(15,23,42); macro-volume-input/macro-intensity-input/macro-progress-input all visible; setting Volumen=75 and clicking Guardar closes modal and toast 'Macrociclo actualizado' shows. Acumulación card Vol bar updates 72% → 75% confirming state propagation and re-render.
test_results_by_feature.mesocycle_edit_modal: PASS – Expanding macrocycle-0 reveals mesocycle-0-0..0-4. Edit on mesocycle-0-0 opens white modal with meso-volume-input/meso-intensity-input/meso-progress-input. Saving Volumen=65 closes modal with toast 'Mesociclo actualizado'.
test_results_by_feature.microcycle_edit_modal: PASS – Expanding mesocycle-0-0 reveals microcycle-0-0-0..0-0-3. Edit on microcycle-0-0-0 opens white modal with micro-volume-input/micro-intensity-input/micro-progress-input. Saving Volumen=88 closes modal with toast 'Microciclo actualizado'.
test_results_by_feature.microcycle_value_persistence_viLocked: PASS – Reopening microcycle-0-0-0 edit modal after save returns micro-volume-input.value = '88'. Manual value is NOT overwritten by rollup (viLocked flag is being set on save as per handleSaveMicrocycle).
test_results_by_feature.structure_render_after_save: PASS – After all 3 saves, structure tab still shows 4 macrocycles (Acumulación/Transformación/Realización/Recuperación) with updated bars; no broken charts or empty states; final macro count = 4.
test_results_by_feature.console_and_page_errors: PASS – 0 page errors, 0 non-hydration console errors during open/save of all 3 modal levels. Only pre-existing hydration warnings unrelated to this change.

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ Modals use className 'max-w-lg bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200' on DialogContent (lines 2856, 2898, 2942) – styling is consistent and uses Tailwind tokens.
✓ data-testid coverage is complete and matches the spec (macro|meso|micro-volume|intensity|progress-input).

✓ viLocked flag is correctly set ONLY when isNew is false (handleSaveMacrocycle/Mesocycle/Microcycle lines 526, 583, 637) – so newly-created items still participate in rollup until manually edited. Sensible design.
✓ computeRollups (line 776) cleanly walks children → parent averaging volume/intensity/progress and skips locked nodes. Math.round/avg() pattern is consistent across 3 levels.
⚠ Minor: file is now 3281 lines — should be split (handlers vs modals vs render) per file-size guideline (>700 lines). Not blocking.

⚠ Minor: mesocycle modal stores Volumen on field name 'volume_percent', microcycle uses 'volume' (line 2959), macrocycle uses 'volume_percent' too. Inconsistent field naming between micro and meso/macro could cause subtle bugs in serializers/exports if not handled. Worth normalizing in a follow-up.
⚠ Pre-existing hydration warnings in Dashboard datos-layout still pollute console (iter 60/61/63). Outside scope of this change.
